excerpts:
## Access, usage, and pricing

### How do I get an API key and pricing?

API access is available by approval. Enter your work email on the [Waterfall website](waterfall.io/) to request a key, or [book a call](waterfall.io/book-a-call) to discuss your workflow and pricing. A member of our team reviews every access request; we aim to reply within a couple of hours. We work with a limited number of customers so we can provide direct support and plan capacity around each team's needs.

Once you have a key, send it in the `x-api-key` header. Follow [Authentication](docs.waterfall.io/v1/authentication.md) and the [Quickstart](docs.waterfall.io/v1/quickstart.md).

### Does my API key enable every capability?

Waterfall API access depends on the features enabled for your key. A valid key can receive a permission error for an unavailable capability, and adding `include_phones: true` requires phone enrichment access. Confirm the capabilities your workflow needs with [the Waterfall team](mailto:support@waterfall.io), and use the [Errors guide](docs.waterfall.io/v1/errors.md) to interpret the returned code.

### How do I see what a request cost?

When `output.usage` is present in a Waterfall result, it reports `total_usd`, counts and costs by category, and `balance_remaining_usd`. For an asynchronous job, retrieve the result before reading its cost. [Usage Tracking](docs.waterfall.io/v1/inline-usage.md) explains the fields. Count each job once when totaling costs; prices in example responses are illustrative, not a price list.

...

For Prospector and contact, phone, or company enrichment, include a `webhook_url` for a compatible receiver to get the completed result. If your setup cannot receive callbacks, save the returned `job_id` and retrieve the result through the matching Finder. Use `custom_fields` to carry your source record ID. Your workflow maps the returned fields and writes them back to the right record.

### Which calls return results immediately?

Waterfall Search Contact, Search Company, Company Titles, Company Reveal, Job Change, and Email Verification return results in the response. Prospector, Contact Enrichment, Phone Enrichment, and Company Enrichment return a `job_id`; retrieve the completed result through the matching Finder or provide a supported `webhook_url`. See [Choose an API](docs.waterfall.io/v1/introduction.md).

A synchronous [Contact Enrichment](docs.waterfall.io/v1/contact-enrichment-launcher.md) option is also available by arrangement for enterprise customers. [Contact our team](mailto:support@waterfall.io) for access details.

### Can I receive enrichment results without polling?

Yes. Waterfall Prospector, Contact Enrichment, Phone Enrichment, and Company Enrichment accept a `webhook_url`. Waterfall sends the Finder payload to that URL when processing completes. Your integration hosts the receiving endpoint and handles the delivery. Follow [Webhook Verification](docs.waterfall.io/v1/webhook-verification.md) for checking signed deliveries, including the documented behavior when the signature header is absent.

results.title: Authentication
excerpts:
# Authentication

> Get access to the Waterfall API, send your API key in the x-api-key header, and manage keys for separate workflows.

Authenticate data and account API requests with your Waterfall API key in the `x-api-key` header. [Contact the team](mailto:support@waterfall.io) for API access and pricing.

```http theme={null}
x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY
```

> [!NOTE]
>
> The API host is `api.waterfall.io`. Data endpoints use `/v1/`; Account Reporter V2 uses `/v2/account`. Use the path shown on each reference page.

## Best practices

* Store keys in server-side environment variables. Keep them out of browser code and public repositories.
* Rotate keys periodically.
* Use [dedicated sub-keys](docs.waterfall.io/v1/api-keys-overview.md) to manage access and usage for separate teams or workflows. Creating and managing sub-keys requires a **master API key**.

# Waterfall API introduction

> Explore Waterfall's APIs and compare their inputs, results, and use cases to choose the right endpoint for your workflow.

The Waterfall API is available at `api.waterfall.io`. Send your API key in the `x-api-key` header. See [Authentication](docs.waterfall.io/v1/authentication.md).

## Endpoints

| API | Type | Description |
| - | - | - |
| [Prospector](docs.waterfall.io/v1/prospector-launcher.md) | Async | Find people at a company by domain and title filters, with available emails and optional phones. |
| [Search Contact](docs.waterfall.io/v1/search-contact-launcher.md) | Sync | Find profiles by LinkedIn, company, or supported company-set and role filters. Emails and phones are excluded. |
| [Search Company](docs.waterfall.io/v1/search-company-launcher.md) | Sync | Find companies by industry, headquarters country, or headcount range. Preview. |
| [Contact Enrichment](docs.waterfall.io/v1/contact-enrichment-launcher.md) | Async | Find profile data and available contact details from an email, LinkedIn identifier, or name and company domain. |
| [Phone Enrichment](docs.waterfall.io/v1/phone-enrichment-launcher.md) | Async | Find available phone numbers for a known person. |
| [Company Enrichment](docs.waterfall.io/v1/company-enrichment-launcher.md) | Async | Find company details from a domain, LinkedIn identifier, or company name. |
| [Company Reveal](docs.waterfall.io/v1/company-reveal-launcher.md) | Sync | Look up company context from an IPv4 address, with entity type and confidence. |
| [Company Titles](docs.waterfall.io/v1/company-titles-launcher.md) | Sync | Retrieve active job titles at a company by domain or LinkedIn identifier. Preview; requires access on your key. |
| [Job Change](docs.waterfall.io/v1/job-change-launcher.md) | Sync | Check a contact's company information and return an employment-change outcome with an available profile. |
| [Email Verification](docs.waterfall.io/v1/email-verifier.md) | Sync | Check a specific email address and return its verification status. |
| [Webhook JWKS](docs.waterfall.io/v1/webhook-jwks.md) | Sync | Fetch public Ed25519 keys for verifying signed webhook deliveries. |
| [Account Reporting](docs.waterfall.io/v1/account-reporter-v2.md) | Sync | Read usage for the account and authenticated key, plus the current account balance. |
| [API Key Management](docs.waterfall.io/v1/api-keys-overview.md) | Sync | List account keys and create or update sub-keys using a master key. |

Choose an API based on what you already know and what you want to find. The guidance below separates search, enrichment, verification, and employment checks.

## Find people and contact details

| API | What you have | What you get |
| - | - | - |
| [Prospector](docs.waterfall.io/v1/prospector-launcher.md) | Company domain + title filter | Matching people, with available emails and optional phones |
| [Search Contact](docs.waterfall.io/v1/search-contact-launcher.md) | Person's LinkedIn, company identifiers, or [company-set filters](docs.waterfall.io/v1/search-contact-filters.md) | Professional profiles; no emails or phones |
| [Contact Enrichment](docs.waterfall.io/v1/contact-enrichment-launcher.md) | Email, person's LinkedIn, or name + company domain | Profile and available contact details |
| [Phone Enrichment](docs.waterfall.io/v1/phone-enrichment-launcher.md) | Email, person's LinkedIn, or name + company domain | Available phone numbers |
| [Email Verification](docs.waterfall.io/v1/email-verifier.md) | Email address | Email verification status |

**Search Contact or Prospector?** Use Search Contact when you need profile search and structured filters. Use Prospector when you have a target account and want to find people and contact details by title. To enrich someone found through Search Contact, pass their LinkedIn identifier to Contact Enrichment. See [account prospecting](docs.waterfall.io/v1/use-cases/account-prospecting.md) for the workflow.

...

For existing CRM records, use [CRM enrichment](docs.waterfall.io/v1/use-cases/crm-enrichment.md). For website traffic, start with [website company identification](docs.waterfall.io/v1/use-cases/website-company-identification.md).

## Check a contact's employment

[Job Change](docs.waterfall.io/v1/job-change-launcher.md) checks a contact's company information and returns a status with an available profile snapshot. Start with a supported company-and-contact identifier combination or a professional email. If you need recurring checks, your workflow schedules the requests and compares the results. See [job changes](docs.waterfall.io/v1/use-cases/job-changes.md).

## When do results arrive?

For **async** APIs, the launcher returns a `job_id`. Retrieve the result with the matching Finder or receive it through `webhook_url`.

For **sync** data APIs, read the result in the POST response. Where a Finder exists, use it to retrieve the saved result later. Email Verification has no Finder.

The job's `status` describes processing. Inspect the returned data to decide whether it is useful for your task. A `SUCCEEDED` job does not promise that every requested field was found.

> [!NOTE]
>
> Search Company and Company Titles are **Preview** APIs. Their behavior may change. Check the relevant reference before building a critical workflow around a Preview API.

## Manage your integration

* [API Keys Management](docs.waterfall.io/v1/api-keys-overview.md): create and manage keys for your workflows.
* [Usage Tracking](docs.waterfall.io/v1/inline-usage.md): inspect a job's returned cost and balance snapshot.
* [Account Reporting](docs.waterfall.io/v1/account-reporter-v2.md): read usage across a date range.
* [Webhook Verification](docs.waterfall.io/v1/webhook-verification.md): verify the origin and integrity of signed deliveries.

Ready to try a contact lookup? Follow the [quickstart](docs.waterfall.io/v1/quickstart.md). If you are comparing providers, use the [evaluation guide](docs.waterfall.io/v1/evaluate-waterfall.md).

Working with an agent? Start with [Use Waterfall with an agent](docs.waterfall.io/v1/skills-overview.md) to run a lookup or build an integration.

results.title: API Keys Management
excerpts:
# API Keys Management

> Create and manage separate API keys for teams, environments, and integrations.

Use a Waterfall master API key to create, list, and modify sub-keys for your account. Separate keys let you track usage by team, environment, or integration and manage each key's active status and request rate limit.

> [!NOTE]
>
> These operations require a master API key. Contact your account manager if you need key management enabled for your account.

## Available operations

| Operation | Endpoint | Use it to |
| - | - | - |
| [List keys](docs.waterfall.io/v1/api-keys-list.md) | `GET /v1/api-keys` | Review keys and their current settings. |
| [Create a key](docs.waterfall.io/v1/api-keys-create.md) | `POST /v1/api-keys` | Add a sub-key with a label and request rate limit. |
| [Modify a key](docs.waterfall.io/v1/api-keys-modify.md) | `PUT /v1/api-keys` | Update a sub-key's label, active status, or request rate limit. |

Authenticate these requests with your master key in `x-api-key`. The master key cannot be modified through these endpoints.

## Track usage by integration

Give each sub-key a clear `notes` label, such as `crm-production` or `signup-enrichment`. Authenticate [Account Reporter](docs.waterfall.io/v1/account-reporter-v2.md) with that key to compare its `key_usage` with overall `account_usage`.

`per_interval` controls requests per 60-second interval. It is a request rate limit, not a spending limit. A sub-key's value cannot exceed the master key's limit.

results.title: API Keys - Create
excerpts:
# API Keys - Create

> Create a sub-key to track and manage API usage for a team, environment, or integration.

Create a sub-key under your Waterfall account. Each key has a label, active status, and request rate limit. See [API key management](docs.waterfall.io/v1/api-keys-overview.md) for how sub-keys fit into your integration.

> [!NOTE]
>
> Requires your **master API key** in the `x-api-key` header.

## Label the integration

`notes` is required. Use a label that identifies where the key will be used.

```json theme={null}
{
  "notes": "signup-enrichment",
  "per_interval": 30
}
```

## Rate limit

If omitted, `per_interval` defaults to `50` requests per 60 seconds. It cannot exceed the master key's `per_interval`. Set it explicitly when the master key's limit is lower or you want a smaller limit for this integration.

After creation, use [List keys](docs.waterfall.io/v1/api-keys-list.md) to review the account's keys or [Modify a key](docs.waterfall.io/v1/api-keys-modify.md) to change a sub-key's settings.


## OpenAPI

````yaml api_specs.yaml POST /v1/api-keys
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: Waterfall
  version: 1.7.0
  description: >-
    Waterfall API provides a broad set of capabilities in V1. Most endpoints are
    asynchronous: you start a job (POST) and then retrieve results (GET). Some
    endpoints return immediate responses. Webhooks are also available to
    simplify asynchronous integrations. Below is an overview of the available
    endpoints:

    #### 1\. Prospector

    Find contacts at target accounts using filters like job titles and location.
    Get contact details such as titles, real-time verified emails, social
    profiles, and phone numbers.

    - **Prospector Launcher:** Start a contact search using a domain name,
    LinkedIn profile, or company name. Returns a `job_id`.

    - **Prospector Finder:** Retrieve results using the `job_id` from the
    Prospector Launcher.


    #### 2\. Contact Enrichment
````

...

````yaml api_specs.yaml POST /v1/api-keys
    Current mapping in this API spec: all endpoints are `GA` except
    `/v1/company-reveal`, `/v1/search/company`, `/v1/job/change`, and
    `/v1/company-titles`, which are `Preview`.


    ---

    # Authentication

    To access the API, you need the API key provided in your contract. You can
    ask for multiple API keys for different teams' usage.

    All API request URLs start with
    [api.waterfall.io/v1/](api.waterfall.io/v1/). Provide your
    API key in the `x-api-key` header.

    ---

    # Rate limit

    The Prospector, Search, Enrichment, Job Change and Verify Email APIs allow a
    maximum of 50 requests per minute (60 seconds). Should you encounter rate
    limit errors or anticipate a need for increased capacity, please reach out
    to your account manager for assistance. There are no rate limits for the
    Account Reporter API.

    ##### X-RateLimit-Limit
````

...

````yaml api_specs.yaml POST /v1/api-keys
        Create a new API key for the account. This endpoint requires
        authentication with a master API key.
      operationId: addApiKey
      requestBody:
        description: >
          Create sub-key payload. `notes` is required. `per_interval` is
          optional; if omitted, the current implementation defaults to 50. The
          value cannot exceed the master key's `per_interval`.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/APIKeyCreateRequest'
            example:
              notes: team-a
              per_interval: 30
        required: true
      responses:
        '200':
          description: API key succesfully created.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/APIKey'
              example:
                api_key: ad18e456-0dd7-45e1-b094-43a0361aedfa
                active: true
                notes: team-a
````

# One GTM API for contacts and companies

> Find prospects, enrich contact and company profiles, find emails and mobile numbers, verify emails, and check job changes with the Waterfall API.

Waterfall brings together 30+ data vendors through one B2B data API. Find people at target accounts, match emails to business profiles, find contact details, and check whether existing contacts have changed jobs.

Use it to build signup enrichment, prospecting, and CRM workflows with the data your team needs. [About Waterfall](docs.waterfall.io/v1/about-waterfall.md) explains how it fits into your stack.

...

## How the API works

Send requests to `api.waterfall.io` with your API key in the `x-api-key` header. [Authentication](docs.waterfall.io/v1/authentication.md) covers access and key management.

Prospector and the contact, phone, and company enrichment APIs return a `job_id`. Use the matching Finder to retrieve the result, or provide a `webhook_url` to receive it. Search and verification APIs return results in the same request. The [API selection guide](docs.waterfall.io/v1/introduction.md) lists the response pattern and availability for each capability.

Every reference page shows the supported inputs and outputs. Use [Usage Tracking](docs.waterfall.io/v1/inline-usage.md) to read returned costs, and [Account Reporting](docs.waterfall.io/v1/account-reporter-v2.md) for usage across a date range.

For API access, pricing, or help choosing the right workflow, [talk to the Waterfall team](mailto:support@waterfall.io). Common product and integration questions are covered in the [FAQ](docs.waterfall.io/v1/faq.md).

sources.title: API Keys Management - Waterfall.io API Documentation
sources.trimmed:
Use a Waterfall master API key to create, list, and modify sub-keys for your account. Separate keys let you track usage by team, environment, or integration and manage each key’s active status and request rate limit.

These operations require a master API key. Contact your account manager if you need key management enabled for your account.

## Available operations

| Operation | Endpoint | Use it to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| List keys | `GET /v1/api-keys` | Review keys and their current settings. |
| Create a key | `POST /v1/api-keys` | Add a sub-key with a label and request rate limit. |
| Modify a key | `PUT /v1/api-keys` | Update a sub-key’s label, active status, or request rate limit. |

Authenticate these requests with your master key in `x-api-key`. The master key cannot be modified through these endpoints.

## Track usage by integration

Give each sub-key a clear `notes` label, such as `crm-production` or `signup-enrichment`. Authenticate Account Reporter with that key to compare its `key_usage` with overall `account_usage`.
`per_interval` controls requests per 60-second interval. It is a request rate limit, not a spending limit. A sub-key’s value cannot exceed the master key’s limit.

sources.trimmed:
## Access, usage, and pricing

### How do I get an API key and pricing?

API access is available by approval. Enter your work email on the [Waterfall website](waterfall.io/) to request a key, or [book a call](waterfall.io/book-a-call) to discuss your workflow and pricing. A member of our team reviews every access request; we aim to reply within a couple of hours. We work with a limited number of customers so we can provide direct support and plan capacity around each team's needs.

Once you have a key, send it in the `x-api-key` header. Follow [Authentication](docs.waterfall.io/v1/authentication.md) and the [Quickstart](docs.waterfall.io/v1/quickstart.md).

### Does my API key enable every capability?

Waterfall API access depends on the features enabled for your key. A valid key can receive a permission error for an unavailable capability, and adding `include_phones: true` requires phone enrichment access. Confirm the capabilities your workflow needs with [the Waterfall team](mailto:support@waterfall.io), and use the [Errors guide](docs.waterfall.io/v1/errors.md) to interpret the returned code.

### How do I see what a request cost?

When `output.usage` is present in a Waterfall result, it reports `total_usd`, counts and costs by category, and `balance_remaining_usd`. For an asynchronous job, retrieve the result before reading its cost. [Usage Tracking](docs.waterfall.io/v1/inline-usage.md) explains the fields. Count each job once when totaling costs; prices in example responses are illustrative, not a price list.

...

For Prospector and contact, phone, or company enrichment, include a `webhook_url` for a compatible receiver to get the completed result. If your setup cannot receive callbacks, save the returned `job_id` and retrieve the result through the matching Find

sources.trimmed:
# Authentication

> Get access to the Waterfall API, send your API key in the x-api-key header, and manage keys for separate workflows.

Authenticate data and account API requests with your Waterfall API key in the `x-api-key` header. [Contact the team](mailto:support@waterfall.io) for API access and pricing.

```http theme={null}
x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY
```

> [!NOTE]
>
> The API host is `api.waterfall.io`. Data endpoints use `/v1/`; Account Reporter V2 uses `/v2/account`. Use the path shown on each reference page.

## Best practices

* Store keys in server-side environment variables. Keep them out of browser code and public repositories.
* Rotate keys periodically.
* Use [dedicated sub-keys](docs.waterfall.io/v1/api-keys-overview.md) to manage access and usage for separate teams or workflows. Creating and managing sub-keys requires a **master API key**.

# Waterfall API introduction

> Explore Waterfall's APIs and compare their inputs, results, and use cases to choose the right endpoint for your workflow.

The Waterfall API is available at `api.waterfall.io`. Send your API key in the `x-api-key` header. See [Authentication](docs.waterfall.io/v1/authentication.md).
